name: Barycentric Projected Tetrahedron Tessellation
definition: A method to determine the silhouette shape and tessellation of a projected tetrahedron under perspective projection by computing the barycentric coordinates of the eye position with respect to the tetrahedron vertices.
summary: Barycentric Projected Tetrahedron Tessellation is a volume rendering method that uses barycentric coordinates to ensure geometrically correct interpolation of thickness and density under perspective projection.
